header: Several quotes, shown one at a time
lead: The row scrolls without a script: drag it, swipe it, or tab in and use the arrow keys. Two buttons help mouse users and fade out at either end.

quotes.quote_text: We replaced three testimonial sliders with this one. It scrolls without a script, and the arrows are there for mouse users.
quotes.author: Jonas Pichler

image.alternative: A man in his fifties with grey stubble and a dark gilet.

quotes.quote_text: Every card has the same layout, so a short quote and a long one still line up in a row.
quotes.author: Miriam Kaltner

image.alternative: A woman in her fifties with short grey hair and a dark jacket.

quotes.quote_text: On my phone I just swipe. The next card peeks in at the edge, so I can see there is more.
quotes.author: David Gruber

image.alternative: A man in his thirties with a beard and a light blue shirt.
